Schemes affected by terrorism in NER
†1916. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that all the projects
being undertaken in North-Eastern States
have become victim of terrorism;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Ministry of Power has warned about the
threat of security of the personnel engaged
in these projects;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether it is also a fact that incidents
of gruesome killings of a number of
employees/officers of Indian Oil
Corporation have taken place recently; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of PM's Special
Packages for NER
1917. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the Ministries which have not
complied with national commitment through
various PM's Special Packages for NER
indicating actual percentage of budgetary
provisions made, utilized and amount
transferred to Non-lapsable Pool of
Resources during last three financial years;
and
(b) the action taken against departments
for not complying with this national
commitment?
Economic packages announced by
PM for NER
1918. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government for
development of North Eastern Region under
the various economic packages announced
by the Prime Minister from time to time;
and
(b) the details of funds released, so far,
and the demand made by each State of
NER?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Bunglings in hotels of ITDC
†1919. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Intelligence
Bureau (IB) has revealed certain instances
of bunglings in various hotels of ITDC on
the request of his Ministry;
(b) if so, the full details of the bunglings;
(c) the officials found responsible for
this; and
(d) the action Government propose to
take against the culprits?
Valuation of fixed assets of PSUs
1920. SHRI SUNIL SHASTRI: Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
direct all Public Sector Undertakings to get
their yearly valuation of fixed assets done
so as to help determine their values on
demand; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Asset value of disinvested ITDC hotels
1921. SHRI GAYA SINGH:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the asset value of various ITDC
hotels which were disinvested and sold;
and
(b) the criteria on which the asset values
were fixed?
Disinvestment of BPCL and HPCL
1922. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has decided for
disinvestment of BPCL and HPCL;
(b) if so, whether any modalities for their
disinvestment has been decided upon;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) by when disinvestment process is
likely to be started and completed?
Disinvestment of SCI
1923. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the national
flag carrier Shipping Corporation of India
is to be privatised;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that many
foreign firms, who had shown some interest
in SCI, have pulled out;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) whether Government have
considered all pros and cons of country's
security, infiltration, smuggling etc. at the
time of embroiled political situation?
Disinvestment proposal of ITDC
Hotel Kanishka
1924. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have shelved
the disinvestment proposal of ITDC-owned
Kanishka Hotel due to difficulties in
